title: [review] lichend.rs: Cryptographic seed read failure silently ignored
description: The result of `read_exact` from /dev/urandom is discarded with `let _`. If reading fails (file descriptor error, interrupted syscall), the seed buffer `b` remains all zeros or partially filled. This weak/zero seed is then used to derive the node's cryptographic identity, compromising authentication and replay protection for the entire mesh.
close_reason: Fixed: read_exact from /dev/urandom now properly checked with if-let-err pattern; exits with error on failure instead of silently using weak/zero seed
